_comment: PROTECTED — the trading agent may not edit this file, config/lanes.json, or anything in core/. Changes here are made by the human operator only.

engine._comment: Bounds for core/decision.py, the one decision engine behind paper placement, replay and real twins. strategy/risk.json may set min_net_edge at or above min_net_edge_floor and a stake at or below max_stake_usd; it cannot loosen anything here. lambda (market-shrinkage weight per lane) is fitted by the engine from settled forecasts whose outcome was known at decision time: lambda = clip(1 - w_opt, 0, 1) * n/(n + lambda_shrink_k) over n distinct settled events, and 0 below lambda_min_events. max_net_edge rejects implausibly large shrunk edges as a probable mapping or stale-input error (pre-v2 record: claimed edges above 0.10 went 0W/5L in the bet ledger; big sports-devig gaps came from stale, scraped or wrong-day lines, 0/7). Cold start: a lane with status paper and fewer than lambda_min_events settled events trades on paper at lambda_prior_paper, so its forward record (core/gate.py counts paper bets since registration) can start at no real cost; from lambda_min_events on, the fitted lambda rules (and may be 0). A live lane always uses the fitted lambda.

real._comment: Caps for real execution via Pearl Connect (operator machine only). Hard ceilings live in core/validate.py; raising them is a protected-core edit by design. allowed_lanes lists lanes (config/lanes.json) whose paper bets get a real twin; a lane belongs here only with status live, after core/gate.py PASS.
